CustomField.label: Event Type
CustomField.description: ★R6 The format of the event. Values replaced in R6: Symposium / OIP / Conference, in place of Conference / Webinar / Roadshow / Dinner / Gala. Because the picklist is restricted, a record still holding a removed value fails the deploy — scripts/r6-pre-deploy.apex remaps them first and refuses to run until an admin has stated what each old value becomes. Coarse by design: this says what shape the event is, not what it is about. Topic__c carries the subject, and it is Topic__c that similarity should be computed from.
